# Equal forces, unequal accelerations

<!-- STEP id="fruit" -->
From a = F / m: for the fruit, the force gives an acceleration we can see. For the Earth, the same force is divided by a huge mass. Its acceleration is far too small to notice.

<!-- STEP id="gun" -->
A 5 kg gun fires a 0.1 kg bullet with a force of 2 N. By the third law, the bullet pushes the gun back with 2 N too.

Gun: a = 2 N / 5 kg = 0.4 m/s². Bullet: a = 2 N / 0.1 kg = 20 m/s².

**Equal forces do not give equal accelerations when the masses differ.**
